title: Dream about the empty office
summary: On Thursday, Jordan had a genuinely good day at work—with Marcus out, Lena opened up and shared a strong prototype, visibly unused to receiving praise. That night, Jordan had an unsettling dream about an empty, abandoned office with no way out, waking at 4am with a racing heart; a run at Greenwood Park helped calm them physically, but they're left recognizing that the ongoing restructuring is weighing on them more than they'd realized.
